name: Speaking with Gan'zulah
summary: At Grom'gol Base Camp, Gan'zulah curses those who stand over the bubbling pot. The Bloodscalp chieftain demands the deaths of his Skullsplitter rivals and the ruin of their ruler, Ana'thek the Cruel.

sections.title: A Chieftain's Vengeance
sections.body: Gan'zulah's severed head curses anyone who stands over the bubbling pot. Though dead, the Bloodscalp chieftain still hates his captors and ancestral enemies. He points you east toward the Skullsplitter stronghold and demands the deaths of its hunters, headhunters, and berserkers. Their ferocious warband may kill those who dare face it.

sections.title: The Broken Armor
sections.body: Gan'zulah expects the assault to end in disaster. He believes Chief Ana'thek the Cruel will tear apart any intruder who challenges him. Still, he demands Ana'thek's shattered armor as proof of triumph. Bring that trophy back to the cauldron at Grom'gol Base Camp to satisfy Gan'zulah's spite.

sections.title: An Uneasy Peace
sections.body: Gan'zulah falls silent when Ana'thek's shattered armor is brought before him. His rival's defeat at last eases the Bloodscalp chieftain's vengeful rage. He recognizes the strength it took to defeat Ana'thek, but vows their reckoning is only delayed. Gan'zulah swears they will clash again in the Nether.

faq.q: Where does Gan'zulah want you to go?
aliases: where to go speaking with ganzulah
faq.answer: Gan'zulah sends you east into Skullsplitter territory, where their fighters gather under Ana'thek the Cruel.
Ana'thek the Cruel leads the Skullsplitter trolls and is a hated rival of Gan'zulah and the Bloodscalp tribe.

faq.q: Why is Gan'zulah able to talk?
faq.answer: Gan'zulah's severed head rests in the enchanted cauldron at Grom'gol Base Camp. From beyond death, his spirit voices curses and demands.
Gan'zulah demands Chief Ana'thek the Cruel's broken armor and the deaths of the Skullsplitter hunters, headhunters, and berserkers.

faq.q: What comes next after helping Gan'zulah?
faq.answer: After the tribal chieftains are dealt with, you continue the search with The Fate of Yenniku to learn what became of the young Darkspear troll.

angles.text: Gan'zulah's head rests in the cauldron at Grom'gol Base Camp. He sends Horde champions against his Skullsplitter enemies.
As a Darkspear troll, you see the Bloodscalp and Skullsplitter chieftains turn their undying hatred against each other. Their feud shows the jungle's brutality.
